narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Rough Bronze Leggings, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: These are the leggings I ordered, huh? "Three to five business days," they said. More like three to five business MONTHS! I submitted this when I was working for the Venture Co out there, and let me just say, that partnership is well over with, so we can consider this order expired. Why aren't you leaving yet? Ugh, fine! Here's your payment.
